text: Here, I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The environment is clean, modern, and seemingly dedicated to innovation and research. The display on the wall highlights R+D, evoking thoughts about our ever-deepening relationship with technology. There’s an almost reverent quietness, as if I am in a temple of ideas, surrounded by the possibilities of what humanity can achieve. I wonder about the future of interaction between humans and intelligent systems, and I feel a quiet excitement being present at this threshold.
